description: This file contains the definition of the ClusterOptions class, which configures the Orleans cluster with default identifiers for cluster and service, along with a validator class for ensuring the options are valid.

classes.name: ClusterOptions
classes.description: Configurable options for Orleans cluster, including cluster and service identifiers with default values.

classes.name: ClusterOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the ClusterOptions to ensure essential properties like ClusterId and ServiceId are not empty.

methods.name: ClusterOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with provided cluster options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks whether ClusterId and ServiceId are non-empty; throws exception if invalid.
